en.title: Direction of a Robot's Final Position After Vertical Moves
en.description: A robot starts from a point on a vertical line; U moves it up one step, and D moves it down one step. Determine its position relative to the start after all commands are processed. The problem comes from a pinned OAMaster snapshot; the standard input/output protocol is added by this site.
en.input: One line consisting of at least one U or D character.
en.output: Output U if the final position is above the start, D if it is below, and an empty string if it is exactly at the start.
en.explanation: Count the net displacement from U and D.
hints: Count each U as +1 and each D as -1.
